::: {#rem-rarity-source}
#### Source of the name

Leinster calls $1/p_i$ "a measure of [the $i$th species'] rarity or specialness" <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
[@leinster2021entropy, Section 2.4].
We know of no source that names the reciprocal of a [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) outside that setting,
so "rarity" is borrowed from there.

:::
